utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can spread the word and bring any tools or spare parts I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo — that’d really help. I’ll keep spreading the word later and mention the tools and spare parts, too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—keep me posted if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the details organized. Let me know if you can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I can help spread the word, especially around school pickup and drop-off times. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Faye — thank you. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes, and your help at pickup and drop-off will make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ll check my shed and bring over anything useful as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that would really help. I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes once you drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam. I’ll swing by with whatever I find as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help spread the word and make sure folks know about the repair drive and supplies. What part needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think the loose fence by the mailbox is the biggest one, and that broken step near the community room too. I’m still a little fuzzy on the details, so I’d double-check the flyer for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I’ll double-check the flyer for the time and focus folks on the loose fence by the mailbox and the broken step near the community room.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — we’re still lining up volunteers, and sorting donations or doing a quick pickup would be a huge help. If you can, let me know what works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with a quick pickup — I’ll keep an eye out for donations while I’m out and let you know if I find anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Ira — thank you. Just let me know what you find, and I’ll share the pickup details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the invite list going for the repair drive and let folks know anyone helping with supplies is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn. I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo — I’ll add you to the list and spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The flyer and repair list still need a quick check, and I could use help spreading the word. If you can take that on, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can check the flyer and repair list, and I’ll help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — it’s still looking on track for this weekend, and folks are already bringing in tools and spare parts. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll pass that along around the block. Thanks for the update — just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’m hearing a nice mix of volunteers and donations already, so I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many stops are we planning in total, and who’s handling the pickups?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I think we’ve got three stops lined up, and I can handle the first pickup if needed. I’ll check with the others so we can split the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Three stops sounds manageable. Can you tell me the route first so I can judge the drive time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds about right to me. I’ll plan to be there around 9 and bring anything specific I need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—just send me the exact repair list if you get it, so I can double-check the details too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll send over the exact list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, and a couple small hand tools. If I find anything, I’ll bring it over and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey. That’d really help—just bring anything you find by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll drop by with anything I find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t spotted any change yet, but I’ll keep an eye near the school pickup route and let you know if I find the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on, right? And should I be checking more for people to help, or is the timing the main concern?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on — Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday from 10 to 2. Timing’s the main thing for now, but if you spot extra helpers, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Do you want me to look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools, or should I head over and point out the repair spots first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks — could you look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first? I’ll head over later and keep spreading the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the time and any key items, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Probably the most help is with tools and spare parts — I can spread the word and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening, right? Are we more short on people, or is the timing the bigger issue?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still happening as far as I know. I think we’re more short on people than timing, but I’d still double-check the flyer just in case.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so mainly a people gap, and I should double-check the flyer. Thanks, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m still worried about the timing and whether we’ve got enough people lined up. If it’s after 3, I can do a pickup — I just need the route and how many stops there are first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll send you the route and stop count as soon as I have the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — Saturday 10 to 2 at Maple Hall works, and I’ll wait for the route and stop count before I commit to a pickup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye out for a cordless drill and some clamps while I’m out. If I spot anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. Let me know if you find anything, and I’ll be ready to sort and label it when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so I’ll keep my eyes open for both and check back in soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa—just keep me posted on what supplies are still needed, and I’ll help track them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo—I’ll send over the updated list, and the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. Thanks for helping track everything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Rosa—I’ll watch for the updated list and keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still need the final time and repair list before I can help spread the word—can you send those over?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send over the final time and repair list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll wait for the final time and repair list, then I can help with the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just that it’s coming up soon and anyone who wants to help with supplies is welcome. I’ll pass along any updates I hear around the block.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate you keeping folks in the loop. I’ll keep an eye out for any extra supplies and let people know they can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep sharing any updates I hear, and if anyone asks, I’ll tell them supplies help is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Eli — I’m thinking the repair drive could really bring folks together. Want to help me figure out the best way to get the word out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes—let’s keep it simple: a flyer at the mailboxes and a reminder to the neighbors who like to plan ahead. We should mention it starts around 9 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, Eli — I’ll put together a simple flyer for the mailboxes and mention the 9 a.m. start to the planning folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, they’re planning to kick off around 9 in the morning, maybe a little earlier for setup. I’d come by then so you don’t miss the handy folks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll come by around 9 and help with setup. If you need anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great—extra hands would really help, and I’ll let you know if I hear any specific needs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—just send me the time once it’s set, and I’ll work around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I’m still nailing down the exact time, but I’ll send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just let me know when it’s locked in, and I’ll plan around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly we just need hands and a little time—if you can help sort donations or do a quick pickup, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many stops are we planning, and who’s handling the pickups?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still nailing that down, but I can let you know the route and who’s covering pickups as soon as I have it.
